title: Convergence to the Dynamical $Φ^4_3$ Model under a Vanishing Quintic Perturbation I: A Paracontrolled Approach
summary: We study local convergence to the dynamical $Φ^4_3$ model under a vanishing quintic perturbation. More precisely, on the three-dimensional torus we consider $$\partial_tu_\varepsilon=Δu_\varepsilon-\varepsilon^αu_\varepsilon^5+ξ_\varepsilon+C_\varepsilon u_\varepsilon+\widetilde C_\varepsilon u_\varepsilon^3$$ for $α\in(\frac56,1)$, where $ξ_\varepsilon$ is a spatial mollification of space-time white noise. Although the quintic coefficient vanishes, its contractions generate divergent linear and cubic contributions. We identify suitable mass and cubic counterterms that compensate these…
